bibl.title: Dating Papyri: Familiarity, Instinct and Guesswork.
bibl.seg: Malcolm Choat, Dating Papyri: Familiarity, Instinct and Guesswork.
Journal for the Study of the New Testament 42 (2019) pp. 58-83.
bibl.note: Paper presented at an SBL panel (San Antonio, Texas, Nov. 21, 2016). - Surveys the history of palaeographical dating of papyri, reflecting on its origins as a system, and what lessons this might have for contemporary practice: contemporary scholars use an array of methods to date the texts they study, including script, language, content, and the physical properties of the ink and its support. Highlights the importance of understanding the limitations of each of these methods, whether caused by their subjective nature or the current limits of scientific knowledge.
